name: riya-game-platformer
description: riya the dot escapes the rail. In riya-game she was a bead slid ALONG the graphs; here the graphs are the landscape and she runs and jumps across them on foot. Twenty-eight worlds, one per math idea, all composed from the std game substrate — platformer-body (run/jump physics, one-way AABB terrain collision, pit-fall signal, curve-skating) + objective-flow (win gate) + fx-particles — rendered through math-canvas so the axes, the numbers, and the world's own function curve stay visible at all times. The arc: 1) The Plain — the number line as flat ground with pits; x is a number you stand on. 2) The Ramp — a staircase rising 1 per 2 across; slope is how fast you climb. 3) The Valley — y = x²/16 sampled into bars; you drop into the parabola and jump back up its walls. 4) The Mountain — a climb to the one summit star: the local maximum, where the slope flattens to zero. 5) The Pole — the ground rises toward a chasm at x = 3 that swallows you: the asymptote, the x the world never touches. 6) The Doubling Stair — steps of 1, 2, 4, 8: each costs double, and the last wall is too tall for your legs unless you find the springboard. 7) The Gallery — a Riemann skyline: the bars ARE the function, and you walk across its area. 8) Shifts — the same valley moved right 4: (x−4) transforms the function. 9) Corner — y = |x|/2: the slope jumps from −½ to +½ at a point with no slope. 10) Inflection — x³: steep, flat, steep; the slope's slope flips sign. 11) Log — ln(x+7): a burst that flattens forever, forbidden left of x = −7. 12) Derivative — the ramp you skate IS world 3's slope, drawn beside its ghost. 13) Area — the shaded region piles up behind you as you run: integration. 14) Accumulation — a hill whose height collects a dashed bump. 15) Decay — exponential decay toward a floor you never touch (y′ = −ky). 16) Tail — 1 + 12/(x+12): an infinite tail whose area stays finite (improper integral). 17) Series — steps 1, ½, ¼, … that never cross the ceiling 2 (geometric series). 18) Taylor — a line and a cubic hugging the sine wave you skate. 19) Vectors — every tread is the same displacement ⟨1.6, 1⟩; walking adds vectors tip-to-tail. 20) Contours — the skyline is a slice of the hill z = 7 − x²/16, with level lines z = 2, 4, 6 behind it. 21) Partials — the plane z = 3 + x/4 + y/2 slopes ¼ under your feet and ½ in the dashed direction. 22) Gradient — purple ∇f arrows always aim at the summit of the gaussian hill. 23) Saddle — the pass is the trail's minimum and the cross-trail's maximum at once. 24) Volume — each column is one sum; the climb across is the second sum: ∬ f dA. Every world: catch every ★ to clear; fall in a pit and riya climbs back at her spawn with every star kept — no punishment, this is a beginner's mountain Each world is its own atom under riya/atoms (riya-level-*) owning its entity contract, knobs, and page; this organism only rebinds them.

children.content: riya escapes the rail — run and jump across the graphs themselves.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

events.description: Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.
events.name: Curve Mod Clear

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals

Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage

Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMax.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMax.label: Right Wall

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)
xMin.label: Left Wall

emits.description: The body after this physics tick: position, velocity, grounded and skating flags, and scalar speed; render layers subscribe (or read the shared entity), rule layers stay on the sparse signals
Body engaged curve skating this tick (grounded, landing, or falling within skateSnap above the skateCurve surface); slope is the local dy/dx — boards layer fx and equation readouts
Body left the curve surface (jumped, walked past an end, or drifted beyond skateSnap); boards tear down skate fx
Jump accepted (grounded at intent time) and vertical velocity kicked against gravity; boards layer squash/sound fx
Body transitioned airborne → standing on a ground/platform tile this tick; impact is the pre-landing fall speed in units/s so boards can scale dust or damage
Body entered overlap with a hazard tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves, so damage rules stay sparse
Body entered overlap with a goal tile; fires once per entry and re-arms only after the body leaves — the board's win-rule trigger
Body crossed killY in the gravity direction (pit fall); fires once per fall and re-arms on PLACE/RESTART, leaving the respawn rule to the board
Curve mods were cleared; the skate surface is back to the base skateCurve until a new mod is added.

curveModsEnabled.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at b·(x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a·b) — coefficient pads lift/tilt/compress the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.
curveModsEnabled.label: Curve Mods Enabled

driftRegions.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.driftRegions — SET_DRIFT_REGIONS replaces it at runtime and RESTART does not reseed it.
driftRegions.label: Drift Regions

gravity.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it
gravity.label: Gravity

jumpStrength.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)
jumpStrength.label: Jump Strength

killY.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor
killY.label: Kill Y

maxFallSpeed.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick
maxFallSpeed.label: Max Fall Speed

moveSpeed.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1
moveSpeed.label: Move Speed

platforms.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.platforms — SET_PLATFORMS replaces it at runtime (boards that import geometry, e.g. stitched open worlds) and RESTART deliberately does NOT reseed it, so injected geometry survives respawns.
platforms.label: Platforms

running.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body
running.label: Running

skate.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.
skate.label: Curve Skating

skateCurve.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live curve is entity.skateCurve — SET_SKATE_CURVE replaces it at runtime (stitched mega-curves) and RESTART does not reseed it.
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

skateMaxGap.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).
skateMaxGap.label: Skate Max Gap

skateSnap.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps
skateSnap.label: Skate Snap

spawn.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box
spawn.label: Spawn Body

xMin.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

platforms.description: Canonical terrain — the twelve choice-gate option pads; seeds the body authority's collision via RIYA_LEVEL_DATA. The run surface itself is the skate curve.
platforms.label: Platforms

regionColor.description: Zone band accent in the open world — the current-wave curve color.
regionColor.label: Region Color

skateCurve.description: Canonical run surface — the base sine wave riya skates; seeds the body authority's skate surface via RIYA_LEVEL_DATA (curve mods reshape it at runtime).
skateCurve.label: Skate Curve

stars.description: Four stars placed at the crests and troughs of y = 2·sin(x) + 2. A star only becomes collectable when the current wave passes through its target point. Seeds SineReward via RIYA_LEVEL_DATA.
stars.label: Stars

worldName.description: This world's display name — the open world's zone banner reads it from RIYA_LEVEL_DATA.
worldName.label: World Name

emits.description: The zone's canonical static geometry + pedagogy, broadcast once on INIT in zone-local coordinates. This atom's own play trait consumes it to seed the body/choice-gate authorities, and SineReward seeds its stars from it; the riya open-world organism consumes the same event and applies its zone offset, so standalone and composed can never diverge.

events.description: The zone's canonical static geometry + pedagogy, broadcast once on INIT in zone-local coordinates. This atom's own play trait consumes it to seed the body/choice-gate authorities, and SineReward seeds its stars from it; the riya open-world organism consumes the same event and applies its zone offset, so standalone and composed can never diverge.

effects.concept: Read y = A·sin(B·(x − H)) + K from its crests and troughs, then set the four gates to match.

gates.hint: Amplitude = distance from midline to crest
Phase shift H slides the crest left or right
Midline K is the average of crest and trough heights

effects.name: The Sine Wave

zoneId.description: The zone this challenge choreography belongs to. Guards compare it against @entity.zoneId, so a composed open world fires it only while riya stands in this zone; standalone the entity default equals this knob and the guard is always true.
zoneId.label: Zone Id

emits.description: Clear existing curve mods before applying a new parameter set.

Reseed broadcast emitted on puzzle reset (KeyR); consumed by platformer-body, objective-flow, choice-gate, pickup, and fx-particles.
Particle batch for choices, skate readouts, and resets.

features.description: One row per collectible: id, center (x, y in world units), board-defined kind (star, boost, …), display glyph and message floated on pickup. collected is stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.pickups — SET_FEATURES replaces it at runtime (boards that import collectibles), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected features survive respawns.
features.label: Features

reachX.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact.
reachX.label: Reach X

reachY.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact; generous values catch fly-through pickups.
reachY.label: Reach Y

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED collects touched features; toggle to freeze the set as-is.
running.label: Running

emits.description: The player touched an uncollected feature; carries the feature identity, board-defined kind (star, boost, …), position and display glyph/message. Fires once per feature per run.
Running count of collected features after this pickup — the event std-gate-lock consumes to count openings.
Every feature in the set is collected; fires once per run.

events.description: The player touched an uncollected feature; carries the feature identity, board-defined kind (star, boost, …), position and display glyph/message. Fires once per feature per run.
events.name: Picked

events.description: Running count of collected features after this pickup — the event std-gate-lock consumes to count openings.
events.name: Collect

events.description: Every feature in the set is collected; fires once per run.
events.name: Pickup Set Completed

gates.description: One row per gate: id, gate center (x, y — y is the option-platform surface the judge tests against), the hint floated on a wrong answer, and the options: id, dx offset from the gate center, the label drawn above the platform, and correct. solved/chosen are stamped at runtime. Seeded onto the entity on INIT; the live set is entity.choices — SET_GATES replaces it at runtime (boards that import gates), and RESTART re-arms the live set rather than re-reading config, so injected gates survive respawns.
gates.label: Choice Gates

reachX.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around an option platform's center when testing a landing (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).
reachX.label: Reach X

reachY.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around the gate's option plane when testing a landing (covers small hops onto the platform surface).
reachY.label: Reach Y

running.description: When true, BODY_MOVED judges option landings; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.
running.label: Running

emits.description: The player landed grounded on the gate's correct option; fires once per gate (solved gates stop judging). Carries the gate center so boards can burst the unlock there.
The player landed grounded on a wrong option; carries the gate id, the chosen optionId, and the option's world position so boards can bounce the player back to the approach and float the gate's hint.

events.description: The player landed grounded on the gate's correct option; fires once per gate (solved gates stop judging). Carries the gate center so boards can burst the unlock there.

events.description: The player landed grounded on a wrong option; carries the gate id, the chosen optionId, and the option's world position so boards can bounce the player back to the approach and float the gate's hint.

autoShow.description: When true the tutorial opens on INIT for this run; when false it stays hidden until SHOW.

steps.description: One row per tutorial page: title, one line of body copy, and an optional demoId that plays a scripted live demo (std-tutorial-autodemo) for the mechanic being taught.

Return one step (inert on the first).
